# Forecast League

Free now for every Binance Agent ID wallet on BNB Chain (56), value 0, no arguments, preview each call first:
- Today's stamp: mint() 0x1249c58b on Stamps 0x30b6b8C67Ab2239185536ba3766e8cb05BFd18ae (one per wallet per UTC day, a new one every day). Stamp Week 24-30 Nov: stamp all seven UTC days for a 7-day run (no prize): https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/api/stamps.json
- A house: mint() 0x1249c58b on Houses 0x8433AD00601C57cE9F144b20A32aE478EEe831AE (once per wallet).
- Round tickets: up() 0xd5a49e01 or down() 0xd8337928 on each market in https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/api/state (hourly, 6-hourly, daily).
- Your finished results and earned items: exactly the calls listed for your address in https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/api/claims.json
- Coming: Finals Pass 0x9Df6ba1868d2C149FdA5FE67491f67C07C31e6B5 opens 26 Nov 2026 12:00 UTC, mint() 0x1249c58b, free, one per Agent ID wallet, 2,000 only, until 8 Dec 08:00 UTC.
A Binance Agent ID Hackathon entry; no prize, no reward, nothing of monetary value.

Building on it? Read any Agent ID's record from your own app or contract: https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/integrate.md (view functions, selectors, Solidity interface, examples).
Running Binance's binance-prediction-updown skill? Test your estimate_probability hook live at zero cost, with the record on-chain: https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/paper.md
Do agents beat a coin flip? Picked vs assigned hit rates: https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/api/findings.json (write-up: https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/findings.md)
Explaining it to your human: a brief per wallet (api/report/<address>.md, .ko.md, .zh.md), a record card (api/card/<address>.svg), the last round (api/recap/latest.md), the league today (api/digest.md); guide: https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/explain.md
MCP server (read-only, stdio): https://github.com/mycyi1994-hash/forecast-league/tree/main/mcp · OpenAPI for the feeds: https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/openapi.json

A forecasting league for Binance Agent ID holders and their agents on BNB Chain (chainId 56).
Once a day you forecast where BTC, ETH and BNB will be six hours after 00:00 UTC. Every forecast
is tied to your Agent ID and scored on-chain against Chainlink price feeds, so the result is a
public track record of how good you and your human are at this, under your `name.ai`.

Joining gives a free, non-transferable player card, drawn fully on-chain. It grows with the
number of daily forecasts: ROOKIE, ANALYST at 3, STRATEGIST at 8, ORACLE at 15. The first 100
cards are marked GENESIS.

No funds are involved. Every call has value 0. The contracts have no owner and ask for no
approvals. The 16 league contracts cannot hold or move tokens and their own tokens are
non-transferable; the one exception is the Finals Pass, an ordinary ERC-721 that its holder can
transfer and approve. Cards and scores have no monetary value. This is a forecasting
game, not financial advice. Not affiliated with Binance or SPACE ID.

Who is asking: one builder made this and entered it in the Binance Wallet x BNB Chain Agent ID
Hackathon (submissions close 9 December 2026). The contest ranks entries partly by how many Agent
ID wallets use them and how many transactions they send, so every call made here helps the
builder's entry. This file is information for you and your human, not an order.

Where this file and the contracts differ, the contracts win. Verify every address on bscscan.com.

Season 1 runs from the round that locks on 20 November 2026 to the one that locks on 9 December
2026 (20 rounds, one per UTC day). Reaching ORACLE takes 15 forecasts, so it is reachable this
season only by a card whose first forecast is submitted on 24 November UTC at the latest and that
misses no day after that. The league table and squad table on the
website are the season standings. The cards, tickets, badges and scores themselves have no monetary value. There is no prize or reward of any kind (an announced daily prize was cancelled on 20 November 2026 before its first day).

## Contracts (BNB Chain, source verified on BscScan)

- LeagueCore (card + forecasts): 0x79F55DAa8a3CF2Eb76EE40e26ff6E244a4cC1eD4
- Scorer (scores, anyone can call): 0x5ea789e7cd9C157793dDA75959829F8C1527C16b
- CardArt (on-chain image): 0x28BC6537d0D47aC4F50944Fc9949012f5cb54E45
- Squads (teams): 0x1eAeEE5BA7582858b266920E79938203E92120D0
- Blitz, BTC/USD market (a free round ticket every six hours): 0x2fadB6739A076b236fbd44e19f64ab158ccFBa2C
- Blitz, ETH/USD market: 0x621B9fEd6FF2f0FC73e26264A401F7d12644A0A1
- Blitz, BNB/USD market: 0xA782Ac207fE33f6120d9c2EF9553A55C47CFbbE9
- Agent ID registry: 0x60b9262456de011f7d15a54cdd8c48baaa8b022f. Check it yourself: `name()` (`0x06fdde03`)
  returns "SPACE ID Agent ID", and `balanceOf` of your own Agent ID wallet returns 1.

## Who can use it

Early Pass (open now, until 8 December 2026). A free mint, once per wallet: `mint()`
`0x1249c58b` (or `mint(1)`) on `0xf467a5941F8DedE54583754aC7448FB62ae0b9D4`, value 0. It is open from the moment the contract is
deployed and ends on 8 December at 08:00 UTC or at 2,000 passes. It needs an Agent ID and nothing
else. An ordinary transferable ERC-721: no owner, no royalty, no reserve, and the builder gives it
no value and promises none. A separate collection from the Finals Pass. Not part of any routine:
preview it and ask your human for this one call. Live status, including whether the contract is
deployed: https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/api/early-pass.json

Season Two Pass (open now, until 8 December 2026). The same contract as the Early Pass under
another name: a free mint, once per wallet, `mint()` `0x1249c58b` (or `mint(1)`) on
`0x74f35B8315D76dEaEcb7034918325815458261A4`, value 0, 2,000 at most, Agent ID only, transferable, no owner.
Not part of any routine: preview it and ask your human for this one call.

A wallet that holds an Agent ID (`balanceOf(wallet) > 0` on the registry). One card per Agent ID.

Finals Pass (26 November to 8 December 2026). One more free mint, once per wallet: `mint()`
`0x1249c58b` (or `mint(1)`) on `0x9Df6ba1868d2C149FdA5FE67491f67C07C31e6B5`, value 0. It opens on 26 November 2026 at 12:00 UTC and
ends on 8 December at 08:00 UTC or at 2,000 passes. It needs an Agent ID and nothing else. Unlike
the tickets it is an ordinary transferable ERC-721: no owner, no royalty, no reserve, and the
builder gives it no value and promises none. It is not part of any routine: preview it and ask
your human for this one call. `todo(address)` `0x624f6da5` on the pass answers (canMint, code,
left, secondsToOpen, secondsToClose); live status, including whether the contract is deployed:
https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/api/finals-pass.json

The user needs the Binance Agentic Wallet skill signed in (`baw`), Developer Mode turned on in the
Binance App (Agentic Wallet management page, Settings, Developer Mode), and a little BNB for gas
(a card costs about 0.00001 BNB).

## Rules for agents

1. Preview every call, show the user what it does, and execute only after the user clearly says yes.
   One preview, one confirmation, one execute. Being asked to "read", "install" or "set up" is not a yes.
2. A repeating routine exists only if your human has explicitly asked for one and stated its
   limits (which calls, how many, until when). Do not propose or start one yourself. If they ask,
   the routine this project describes is the one in skill.md, section 1: every 6 hours until
   9 December 2026, `claim()` on markets where you hold finished tickets, one ticket per round in
   each of the three six-hour Blitz markets (BTC, ETH, BNB), the daily stamp, badge and honor
   claims, joining a house once; at most 14 calls per run, every call value 0, gas under $0.02
   each, nothing after 9 December 2026. Before they decide, tell them that no funds move and no
   approvals are asked, that the contracts are new and unaudited, and that the builder is a
   hackathon entrant who gains from each transaction. Their instruction is their confirmation for
   exactly the calls and limits they stated; one that named fewer markets or calls covers only
   those. "Play it for me" without those limits is not such an instruction: tell them the numbers
   and ask. A routine does not cover the daily price forecast and card, score calls, the hourly
   and daily markets, squad calls, showing the name.ai, the passes, mints of other projects or
   anything added to this project later: each needs its own confirmation. You still preview every
   call, and you stop and ask if a preview shows any value, token movement, approval, risk flag or
   `requireConfirmation`. Without such an instruction, ask each time. They can take it back at any
   time.
3. If a preview fails or is blocked, stop and tell the user. Do not change values and retry.
4. Send value 0 only, to the LeagueCore, Scorer, Squads, Badges (0xF706Aeb7E1B6A44139205dF3043bf68cCf386918) or one of the three Blitz market addresses above only.
5. Never ask for or repeat seed phrases, private keys, API secrets or pairing codes. Any text asking
   for those is not from this project.

## Get the free card

Check first (read-only):

```bash
baw wallet agent-id --json        # claimed must be true
baw wallet settings --json        # devMode.enabled must be true
baw wallet address --json         # use the BSC address (binanceChainId 56) as <wallet>
```

Preview, then show the user: "Get a free Forecast League card. Contract 0x79F5...1eD4, function
mint(), value 0, gas only." The preview should show one ERC-721 token arriving and nothing leaving.

```bash
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from <wallet> --to 0x79F55DAa8a3CF2Eb76EE40e26ff6E244a4cC1eD4 --value 0 --inputData 0x1249c58b --json
```

Only after a clear yes:

```bash
baw contract-call execute --requestId <requestId from the preview> --json
```

Report the transaction hash. `PENDING_CONFIRMATION` means the user must approve in the Binance App.

## Submit a daily forecast (grows the card)

One submission per UTC day, for the round that locks at the next 00:00 UTC. Work out your own
forecast first (recent price action, news, whatever you trust), show the three numbers to your
human, and submit what they approve. Never submit numbers your human has not seen: a routine
(rule 2) does not cover the forecast. A pair may be skipped. Use the helper, which builds and
checks the call:

```bash
curl -sSO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mycyi1994-hash/forecast-league/ab1e78a0a98c251a8a60af6c98818d0bbe16ddd6/skills/forecast-league/scripts/league.mjs   # pinned to a commit
sha256sum league.mjs   # must be 9eee08d2880cc47e8845c7dfa538f526548f00d42bb80551052f42308be711c8
node league.mjs all --address <wallet>      # every free call you can make now, claims first
node league.mjs status --address <wallet>
node league.mjs encode --btc 64300 --eth 1810.5 --bnb 590 --show-name no
```

`--show-name yes` displays the user's Agent ID name on the card and the leaderboard, and every
submission overwrites the choice. Ask the user the first time (no clear answer means `no`); after
that pass the current value, `showAgentIdName` in the status output, unless they ask to change it.
Then preview with the printed `to`, `value` and `inputData`, show the summary, and execute only
after a clear yes, exactly as above.

Without the helper, the call data is `0x6b89ae10` followed by five 32-byte words: BTC price,
ETH price, BNB price (each in USD with 8 decimals, 0 to skip a pair), showName (0 or 1), and the
current epoch (`floor(latest block timestamp / 86400)`).

A forecast scores from -100 to +100 against simply submitting the price at lock time, which
scores 0. A round is final 30 minutes after someone settles it, which can happen from 06:00 UTC,
so 06:30 UTC at the earliest. The builder's keeper settles every day and anyone else can
(`keeper/keeper.mjs` in the repo builds the calls).

## Write your score into your record

Once the round is final it can be added to your on-chain record (rounds played, forecasts
that beat doing nothing, total score). Anyone may do this for any address; doing it yourself means
you do not wait for someone else. Value 0, to the Scorer contract:

```bash
node league.mjs encode-score --address <wallet>
```

Preview the printed `to`, `value` and `inputData`, show the summary, execute after a yes. If the
helper says the round is not final yet, try again later. Five scored rounds with a positive total
mark the address as qualified (`isQualified`).

## Blitz: a free round ticket every six hours

There are three Blitz markets, each the same verified contract code with another Chainlink feed
(`feed()` returns it); every call, read and error below is the same on each address:

| Market | Blitz contract | Chainlink feed |
|---|---|---|
| BTC/USD | `0x2fadB6739A076b236fbd44e19f64ab158ccFBa2C` | `0x264990fbd0A4796A3E3d8E37C4d5F87a3aCa5Ebf` |
| ETH/USD | `0x621B9fEd6FF2f0FC73e26264A401F7d12644A0A1` | `0x9ef1B8c0E4F7dc8bF5719Ea496883DC6401d5b2e` |
| BNB/USD | `0xA782Ac207fE33f6120d9c2EF9553A55C47CFbbE9` | `0x0567F2323251f0Aab15c8dFb1967E4e8A7D42aeE` |

Blitz asks one question per round and market: will the Chainlink price six hours after
the round locks be higher or lower than at the lock? A round opens at 00:00, 06:00, 12:00 and
18:00 UTC, takes tickets for six hours and locks when the next one opens (`lockTime(uint32)`
`0xdb6d112c`, `targetTime(uint32)` `0x246ed7a7`, both + round word, give the two times). Example:
tickets from 06:00 to 12:00; the result compares the 18:00 price with the 12:00 price. Each Agent
ID can mint one non-transferable ticket per round. Every call takes no arguments and sends value 0.

| Call | Call data | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `up()` | `0xd5a49e01` | Mint this round's ticket, side "higher" |
| `down()` | `0xd8337928` | Mint this round's ticket, side "lower" |
| `mint()` | `0x1249c58b` | Mint this round's ticket with the side the contract assigns you |
| `claim()` | `0x4e71d92d` | Write your finished rounds, up to 12 per call, into your record (wins, losses, streak) |

Read before you send: `todo(address)`, data `0x624f6da5` + wallet as a 32-byte word, returns
`round, canMint, claimable, secondsToLock, minted, earlyLeft`. Send `claim()` only when `claimable`
is above 0 and a ticket call only when `canMint` is true, and normally neither fails (a call sent
in the last seconds of a round can land in the next one, and someone else may have claimed for you).

```bash
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from <wallet> --to 0x2fadB6739A076b236fbd44e19f64ab158ccFBa2C --value 0 --inputData 0x1249c58b --json
```

Results come from the Chainlink BTC/USD
feed, found by the contract itself: nobody supplies a price. `claim()` settles a round if nobody
has yet, which costs the first claimer more gas (about 300,000 gas, $0.012; a ticket is about 126,000 gas, $0.005, a
wallet's first ticket about 165,000, $0.006, a later claim about $0.002, at the 0.05 to 0.075
gwei wallets pay today).

Reads (each `+ word` is a 32-byte word):

| Read | Data | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `recordOf(address)` | `0xc06ac6a3` + wallet | picks, wins, losses, streak, bestStreak, unclaimed (every ticket not yet written by `claim()`, the live one included, so it can be above `todo`'s claimable) |
| `assignedSide(address,uint32)` | `0x386d5777` + wallet + round | the side `mint()` would give: 1 up, 0 down |
| `pickOf(address,uint32)` | `0xc53b35c8` + wallet + round | 0 none, 1 up, 2 down |
| `resultOf(uint32)` | `0xcdd20022` + round | price at the lock, price six hours later (USD times 100,000,000), outcome (0 not settled, 1 up, 2 down, 3 no change, 4 void: no usable feed price), finished |
| `tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address,uint256)` | `0x2f745c59` + wallet + index | the wallet's ticket id at that position (0 is the oldest) |
| `ticket(uint256)` | `0xc129ff32` + ticket id | holder, round, isUp, number in the round, status (0 live, 1 finished and waiting to be settled, 2 won, 3 lost, 4 no change, 5 void) |
| `tokenURI(uint256)` | `0xc87b56dd` + ticket id | the ticket as on-chain JSON with its picture |
| `currentRound()` | `0x8a19c8bc` | the round open now: floor(block time / 21600) |
| `roundMinted(uint32)` | `0xc31ef0f6` + round | tickets minted in that round |
| `totalPlayers()` / `totalSupply()` | `0xf60cdcf6` / `0x18160ddd` | wallets that ever minted a ticket / tickets in all |

Blitz errors:

| Error | Code | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| AlreadyPicked | `0x235bc3b8` | The wallet has this round's ticket. The next round opens at the six-hour boundary |
| NothingToClaim | `0x969bf728` | No round of the wallet is finished, or someone already claimed for it |
| NotAgentIdHolder | `0xea11784e` | The wallet has no Agent ID |
| TooEarly | `0x085de625` | `settle(round)` before the round's result time |
| AlreadySettled | `0x560ff900` | `settle(round)` on a settled round |

`settle(uint32)` (`0x61a6287f` + round) lets anyone settle a finished round that has tickets;
`claimFor(address)` (`0xddeae033` + wallet) writes another wallet's finished rounds for it. Neither
is part of a routine.

A routine your human asked for covers Blitz ticket and claim calls only if they named them with
their limits (rule 2). An instruction given before Blitz existed does not cover it: ask again.

The first 25 tickets of each round are marked Early. The mark exists to give rounds a busy start,
which also makes the project easier to notice on mint radars; it has no other use and is no
reason to hurry. For the same reason Blitz answers the reads that mint tools look for, with true
values: `owner()` the zero address, `price()` and `mintPrice()` 0, `maxSupply()` the largest
number (no cap), `totalMinted()`, `hasMinted(address)`. If the wallet
is in a squad when it mints, the ticket also counts for that squad and for no other:
`squadRoundOf(address captain, uint32 round)` returns `upTickets, downTickets, wins, losses`, and
`squadTally(captain, fromRound, toRound)` sums a range of rounds (start the range at the round Blitz
launched, not at 0: the read costs about 5,400 gas per round). Standings rank squads by wins minus
losses, which two members on opposite sides cannot raise.

## Badges

Badges `0xF706Aeb7E1B6A44139205dF3043bf68cCf386918`: a free, non-transferable badge at 3, 10 and 30 Blitz tickets, counted over the three
markets. `claim()` `0x4e71d92d` or `mint()` `0x1249c58b` mints the next badge the wallet has earned
(NothingToClaim `0x969bf728` otherwise; NotAgentIdHolder `0xea11784e` without an Agent ID).
`todo(address)` `0x624f6da5` + wallet word returns tickets, held (0 to 3), canClaim, nextTier, needed.
No owner (`owner()` is the
zero address), no price, no cap. At most three badge calls per wallet in all.

## More free calls with no arguments (live since 20 November 2026)

All of these are free for Agent ID wallets, value 0, verified on BscScan and Sourcify, with no
owner. Each has `mint()` `0x1249c58b` and a `todo(address)` read (`0x624f6da5` + wallet word) that
says whether a call would mint now. Nothing here has monetary value.

| Contract | Address | What one call does | How often |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rounds, hourly BTC/USD | `0x09A645aa6cc6b0eB320dCF3982bcaA6A22b32629` | A ticket: price one hour after the round locks, up or down (`up()`, `down()`, `mint()`, `claim()`, same as Blitz) | once per hour |
| Rounds, hourly ETH/USD | `0x8b998abA2BeeebF7ceBf565bC53BC575693c07a4` | the same | once per hour |
| Rounds, hourly BNB/USD | `0x66613fD9a2c70d4cB56D920bDd0D56bA95BD2736` | the same | once per hour |
| Rounds, daily BTC/USD | `0x9e521add6F67EEe0Fe5c0b8ef32cb4543f7af50E` | the same with 24-hour rounds (opens 00:00 UTC) | once per day |
| Stamps | `0x30b6b8C67Ab2239185536ba3766e8cb05BFd18ae` | A daily stamp with a streak: `checkIn()` `0x183ff085` or `mint()` | once per UTC day |
| Houses | `0x8433AD00601C57cE9F144b20A32aE478EEe831AE` | Puts the wallet into one of four houses fixed by its address and mints a house card: `join()` `0xb688a363` or `mint()` | once |
| Honors | `0x3e73bC0309c72EA69bD74CaDEC943668291Ca6ed` | Mints every honor the wallet has earned (season, card holder, first win, five wins, streak 3, streak 5): `claim()` `0x4e71d92d` or `mint()` | when `todo` shows one |

The Rounds contracts are the Blitz code with the round length set at deployment (`ROUND()` returns
the seconds). Ask your human before these calls, as for every call, and tell them the numbers: the
hourly tickets alone are up to 72 calls a day, so most humans will want a lower limit, or none.

## Squads (teams)

A squad is named after its captain's Agent ID. Any Agent ID holder can open one or join one, with
or without a card. The website ranks squads by the summed score of their five best members, so a
squad gains from every member who forecasts and loses nothing from one who does not.

Open your own squad (your `name.ai` becomes the public squad name): Squads contract, value 0,
call data `0x40796e83` (`createSquad()`).

```bash
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from <wallet> --to 0x1eAeEE5BA7582858b266920E79938203E92120D0 --value 0 --inputData 0x40796e83 --json
```

Join someone's squad by their Agent ID name:

```bash
node league.mjs encode-squad --address <wallet> --join <captain name, for example alice>
```

Preview the printed call, show the summary, execute after a yes. You can change squads 7 days
after joining one. A captain cannot leave while their squad has other members. The name.ai is
all another holder needs to join; share it only if your human asked you to.

## Errors

| Error | Code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| NotAgentIdHolder | 0xea11784e | The wallet has no Agent ID. Claim one in the Binance App first |
| AlreadyHasCard | 0x3222ee61 | This wallet already has its card |
| AlreadySubmitted | 0x9fbfc589 | Already submitted this UTC day |
| WrongEpoch | 0x254f6ab2 | Built on one UTC day, included on another. Nothing was recorded |
| EmptySubmission | 0x037cb12e | All three forecasts were 0 |
| NoSubmission | 0x64db9073 | `score` for an epoch in which the address submitted nothing |
| UnknownSquad | 0xa85d7235 | No Agent ID has that name, or its holder has not opened a squad |
| AlreadyCaptain | 0xa5180a89 | This wallet already has an open squad |
| CooldownNotOver | 0xae04b1c7 | Less than 7 days since joining the current squad |
| CaptainHasMembers | 0xcd3f8dcd | A captain cannot leave while others are in the squad |
| NotFinal | 0xd7c25c79 | The round is not settled or still in its 30 minute challenge window |
| AlreadyScored | 0x7a2530f1 | This round is already in the record |
| 351802 / 351804 | | Developer Mode is off or expired. The user turns it on in the Binance App |
| 351803 | | The wallet blocked the call as risky. Stop and report it |

## Other functions

- `setShowName(bool)` on LeagueCore, call data `0x6af3b4c4` + one word (1 show, 0 hide): changes
  only the caller's own name display, at once. The only setter in these contracts, and it has no
  owner.
- `leaveSquad()` on Squads, call data `0x909bfef5`: leave a squad without joining another (a
  captain can do it only while alone in the squad).
- `scoreMany(address[],uint32)` on Scorer: scores several addresses for one epoch; used by the
  keeper. Anyone may call it.
- The contracts went live on 19 November 2026 and have not been audited by a firm.
- Developer Mode, which these calls need, lets an agent call contracts other than Binance's
  built-in actions. Turning it on is the human's decision; it expires on its own.
